services.name: For Rental Property Owners
services.desc: Utilities are one of the largest controllable costs for rental properties. If you own or manage a rental, Tacoma Power has programs to help you reduce operating costs, improve energy efficiency, boost profits and save your tenants some money on their energy bills. For rental properties with one to four units, we offer loans, rebates, contractor discounts, and in-store deals for energy efficient upgrades like heating & cooling systems, insulation, windows, water heaters, thermostats, and more. Take a look at all the offers and products we have for residential properties here. If you decide to proceed with a project that has one to four units, use this form: Residential programs application

services.name: Wildlife & Lands
services.desc: Generating clean, renewable hydropower goes hand in hand with caring for the lands and natural resources surrounding our hydro projects. Across western Washington, Tacoma Power and our partners manage approximately 22,000 acres of land associated with our four hydroelectric projects. These lands provide important habitat for fish, wildlife and native plants. Our Wildlife & Lands team works to protect and enhance habitat, monitor wildlife, restore native vegetation and steward natural and cultural resources associated with our hydro projects.
